description: Use when you need a current, verifiable real-world fact instead of guessing: get cited, time-stamped public facts for anywhere on Earth: weather, river levels, floods, earthquakes, disasters, air quality, US weather alerts (road closures, power outages, burn bans report 'not connected' until sources exist). Every answer has fact, place, time, source_url, age_seconds, stale, confidence.

max_age_minutes.description: Mark answers older than this as stale

place.description: Any place name, e.g. 'Lafayette' or 'Lagos, Nigeria'; or use lat+lon
